review_reason: The trial was terminated extremely early (n=5 of planned enrollment) following Trial Steering Committee recommendation, with the primary safety/feasibility endpoint formally unassessed. The critical finding of 0/4 myocardial transduction by qPCR suggests delivery failure, but n=4 is too small to draw definitive conclusions about the AAV1 delivery route. It is unclear whether the early termination was driven primarily by the safety signals (which are expected in a very sick LVAD population and may not be drug-related), the delivery failure, or administrative/commercial factors. Expert review is needed to determine: (1) whether the percutaneous delivery route was the cause of transduction failure vs. patient-specific factors; (2) whether the SAEs in the treatment arm (death, transplant, worsening HF) were attributable to the intervention or to the underlying disease severity; and (3) whether the operational_failure classification is appropriate given that the delivery failure itself constitutes a mechanistic finding.
